description: 87/99 "Am Wasserturm" is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by stadt-gifhorn.de. The development plan determines the structural use for a sub-area of the municipal area. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "87/99 "At the water tower"" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Gifhorn, B-Plan, inspireidentifiziert, Bebauungspläne, Stadtgebiet. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
